snippet.title: SoulQuest | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
SoulQuest is a fast-paced, hack-and-slash, 2D action platformer that follows Alys, a warrior driven by undying love and boundless grief. As she carves through endless hordes and battles the gods themselves, players must master a deep freeform combat system to stand against the Goddess of Death and fulfill Alys’ tragic quest.

With brutal boss fights, soul-ripping mechanics, and a deep freeform combat system, SoulQuest is an action-packed fusion of myth, movement, and mastery.
